From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Thompson <aisha@catalystpay.com>, Roland Meyers <rmeyers@catalystpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Final MAP handoff — SOC 2 / SIG bridge notes & retention clarifications

Hi Aisha / Roland —

Thanks again for the productive session yesterday. As promised, I’m sending the concise MAP handoff for Catalyst Payments with the security/compliance acceptance gates called out so your procurement and security teams can align on the close timeline. High-level asks below, and I’ve attached the evidence index and a SIG-lite matrix to speed review.

Summary (target close: 2028-07-12):
- SOC 2 Type II: provide SOC 2 report summary + mapping to our shared controls; final evidence set by 2028-07-05.
- SIG / CAIQ (SIG-lite): complete the SIG-lite matrix; Redwood will fill all items marked "vendor-supplied" and provide supplemental docs.
- DPA: legal redline attached (DPA_redline_v3.docx). Please flag any outstanding carve-outs by 2028-07-03 so we can route to legal.
- Data retention & residency: default retention policy is 90 days for ephemeral request logs, 365 days for aggregated telemetry; EU residency available if requested (additional MSA addendum). Confirm desired retention windows by 2028-07-02.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2_summary_2028.pdf (2p), SIG-lite-matrix.xlsx, DPA_redline_v3.docx, evidence-index.csv

Next steps (we recommend):
1) Procurement: confirm milestone approvals + preferred signer for DocuSign (Procurement or Legal).
2) Security: quick pass on SIG-lite and SOC2_summary; comment on any evidence gaps by July 3.
3) Redwood (Jordan/Marcus): gather missing artifacts and share a Drive folder link for read-only review.

If you want, Jordan can run a 30-min walk-through of the SOC2 mapping early next week.

Thanks —

Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Final MAP handoff — SOC 2 / SIG bridge notes & retention clarifications

Thanks Naomi — good summary. A couple of clarifying questions from security/procurement so we can commit to the July 12 close: 

1) Retention/residency: the default windows you specified (90/365) are fine, but can you confirm where request logs and KV caches are stored (region) and whether the logs contain PII or hashed identifiers? Our compliance team needs specifics to sign off.

2) SOC 2 evidence: will you provide system-level configs and user access lists, or just the control narrative + exception logs? We may want evidence for encryption-at-rest key rotation and access review artifacts.

3) DPA timeline: we'll get legal to redline by Friday, but curious if you have an in-house KMS/HSM SOC note we can reference (to keep the redline minimal).

If easier, Jordan — can you join a 20-min sync tomorrow to walk through the evidence index?

—Roland
Roland Meyers
Head of Security Programs | Catalyst Payments
rmeyers@catalystpay.com | +1 646-555-3321
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Roland Meyers <rmeyers@catalystpay.com>, Aisha Thompson <aisha@catalystpay.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: Final MAP handoff — SOC 2 / SIG bridge notes & retention clarifications

Roland — thanks for the questions, answers below and linking the evidence folder for read-only review.

Quick answers:
- Retention/residency: request logs and ephemeral KV caches are kept in the region selected on onboarding; for Catalyst we currently default to us-west-2. Logs contain request metadata and hashed identifiers only (no raw card or full SSN). We will mark fields in the evidence-index.csv.
- SOC 2 evidence: we’ll provide the control narrative, system configuration exports (redacted where appropriate), key rotation logs (KMS rotation events), and a sampled access review report. Expect these in the shared Drive folder by EOD 2028-07-01.
- KMS/HSM note: Redwood uses a managed KMS with multi-region CMK and rotation policies; Marcus has the brief SOC note and HSM reference ready to attach.

Read-only evidence bucket (internal link): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CATA-0412/evidence (will contain SOC2_summary_2028.pdf, evidence-index.csv, sample access review, KMS_rotation_log.txt, SIG-lite-matrix.xlsx)
DocuSign prep link (for procurement): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/CATA-0412/DPA

Proposed micro-plan for close (short):
- By 2028-07-01: Redwood uploads artifacts to Drive.
- By 2028-07-03: Catalyst security and legal comment on SIG-lite and DPA.
- By 2028-07-05: Redwood addresses any small evidence gaps; exchange final signers.
- By 2028-07-12: Target signature & mutual ramp.

Let us know which two time slots tomorrow you prefer for a 20-min sync and we’ll block.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199

Thanks Naomi / Jordan — this is helpful and the proposed timeline works for us.

Roland and I reviewed the evidence index; two quick asks: 
- If possible, redact the exact user IDs in the access review sample and leave role mappings + timestamps (we can sign NDA for anything beyond that).
- Please confirm that EU residency is available as an addendum and any cost delta (we will escalate if needed).

Procurement: preferred signer will be Procurement Director (procurement@catalystpay.com). We’ll aim to return redlines by 2028-07-03. Please send DocuSign route once redlines are addressed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Aisha
